messages.subject: Re: More thresholds than categories
parts:
On 10/03/2015 11:11 PM, Ivan W wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I have the following code for a single indicator latent variable:
>
> data$x1<-ordered(ifelse(data$x1<=1, data$x1, "NA"))

Carefully note that you have NA between quotes, making it a string. So
you created an ordered variable with 2 categories.

If think you intended this:

data$x1<-ordered(ifelse(data$x1<=1, data$x1, NA))

Yves.
